cpu.thread: threadCpuUsage optional, separate local thread scope, never substituted for process CPU

wall.frequency: positive signed int64 counts per second; obtain at initialization, retain success+raw frequency, same boot domain
wall.conversion: exact milliseconds rational (end-start)*1000/frequency; retain numerator/denominator; native implementation must use checked quotient/remainder or wide/multiword arithmetic, no overflow wrap
wall.bounds: delta>=0 and delta<2^63; reject raw range overflow/reverse/frequency drift
wall.apiFailure: NOT_OBTAINED, no clock fallback, no zero fill

cpu.wallComparison: process CPU may exceed wall on multicore; never clamp or classify as fake solely for that
cpu.creationExit: absolute FILETIME1601 epoch is identity/exit metadata, not CPU; live-process exit FILETIME undefined

threadAlternative.status: OPTIONAL_NOT_OBTAINED; separate thread incarnation and sample boundary, not process CPU

boundary.start: monitor.enrolled sample group before monitored dispatch
boundary.end: monitor.exit-observed or named terminal-failure sample group; no STOP/ACK substitution
boundary.included: native own setup after start, polling/IPC/stop decisions and clock read overhead between samples
boundary.excluded: pre-start process creation/import, after-end cleanup/write, other actors work; process CPU includes all M threads
boundary.sampling: QPC+CPU reads not atomic; group ID binds order/brackets and acquisition results. Do not claim exact simultaneous wall/CPU endpoints.

R.elapsed: NOT_OBTAINED until own monotonic provider/version/raw units/frequency/domain fixed
R.causality: nonce/seq/receipt linkage only; not a shared clock

componentsFG.F: offline classification over saved raw; no observation clock
componentsFG.G: each writer uses its actual owner process P or M clock; no generic Node API on native M

failureRules: CPU missing PARTIAL with wall retained
no physical PASS from synthetic recomputation
